title: Allison's Assault and Recovery
description: The interns manage the case of Allison, a rape victim found with severe injuries. The arc follows her medical treatment, the revelation of her self-defense, and her recovery process.
interfering_episode_characters: Cristina Yang; Miranda Bailey; Preston Burke
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith learns about Allison, a rape victim with severe injuries. Allison undergoes surgery. Meredith identifies the cause of Allison's injury as the rapist's penis. The rapist arrives at the hospital with severe injuries. Derek performs an emergency craniotomy on Allison. Allison begins to wake up post-surgery.

title: Medical Case: The Blue Baby
description: Meredith becomes involved in a medical case concerning a baby with a heart murmur, leading to her participation in the baby's surgery.
interfering_episode_characters: Pediatric Intern; Mr. Johnson; Mrs. Johnson; Dr. Kay
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith notices a baby turning blue in the nursery. She raises concerns about a heart murmur. Meredith discusses her concerns with Burke. Burke takes over the case and authorizes Meredith's involvement. Meredith assists in the baby's surgery.

title: Language Barrier and Fear of Deportation
description: Izzie navigates the challenges of treating patients with language barriers and fears of deportation, highlighting the complexities of providing medical care in a diverse community.
single_episode_progression_string: Izzie encounters Ms. Lu, who speaks Cantonese, and struggles to communicate. Ms. Lu reveals her daughter Ahn is injured outside. Izzie finds Ahn with a head injury and learns she fears deportation. Izzie treats Ahn's injury discreetly outside the hospital. Ms. Lu thanks Izzie in Cantonese before leaving.

title: Meredith and Derek's Professional and Personal Entanglement
description: Meredith Grey and Derek Shepherd navigate a complex relationship that begins with a one-night stand and evolves as they work together at Seattle Grace Hospital. Their personal history complicates their professional interactions, especially as Meredith strives to prove her competence amidst Derek's favoritism and the eventual arrival of his estranged wife, Addison. The season explores their tension, attraction, and Meredith's struggle to maintain professional boundaries.
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith tells Derek she won't go out with him. Derek asks if she wants to, but she declines. They kiss in the elevator. Meredith accuses Derek of sexual harassment. Derek brushes off her accusation. Meredith decides to take the stairs instead of riding the elevator with Derek.

title: Interns' Professional and Personal Growth
description: A group of new interns, Meredith, Cristina, George, and Izzie, form a bond as they navigate the challenges of their medical internship. Their evolving friendships provide emotional support and camaraderie, helping them tackle complex medical cases and personal dilemmas. The season showcases their growth through handling difficult cases, supporting each other, and overcoming personal and professional challenges.
single_episode_progression_string: Meredith struggles with the decision of choosing roommates among her fellow interns. The interns support each other during their tasks, showcasing their growing bond. Meredith eventually agrees to let George and Izzie move in with her, solidifying their friendship.

title: George O'Malley's Journey to Competence
description: George O'Malley, an intern at Seattle Grace Hospital, faces challenges in building his confidence and proving his competence. Throughout the season, he struggles with self-doubt and strives to demonstrate his abilities to his peers and superiors, leading to personal and professional growth.
interfering_episode_characters: Cristina Yang; Meredith Grey; Miranda Bailey
single_episode_progression_string: George forgets his badge and has to go back to retrieve it. George almost gets run over by Cristina. George mentions his mom irons his scrubs, hinting at his lack of independence. George boasts about being on the code team but is told to stop talking by Cristina. George's pager goes off, and he runs to a critical situation. George starts giving orders during a code. George has to call the time of death for a patient.

title: Izzie Stevens' Professional Challenges
description: Izzie Stevens, an ex-model turned surgical intern, faces professional challenges and biases due to her past. She strives to demonstrate her competence and commitment in the high-pressure environment of Seattle Grace Hospital, advocating for her patients and overcoming personal and professional obstacles. The season highlights her struggles with language barriers, patient advocacy, and determination to succeed despite these challenges.
single_episode_progression_string: Izzie encounters a language barrier with Ms. Lu, a Chinese patient. Izzie stitches Ms. Lu's arm without understanding her concerns. Ms. Lu later brings her daughter Ahn, who is injured and undocumented. Izzie treats Ahn outside the hospital to avoid legal issues. Izzie gives Ahn her pager number for follow-up care.

title: Bailey's Mentorship and Leadership
description: Miranda Bailey, known for her strict yet effective leadership style, mentors the new interns at Seattle Grace Hospital. Throughout the season, she guides their development as surgeons, balancing her professional responsibilities while navigating the hospital's power dynamics. Her influence shapes the interns' experiences and impacts their professional growth.
interfering_episode_characters: Meredith Grey; Derek Shepherd; Richard Webber; Preston Burke; Cristina Yang; Alex Karev; George O'Malley; Izzie Stevens
single_episode_progression_string: Bailey assigns tasks to the interns. She takes a mocha latte from Meredith but refuses to let her assist in surgery. Bailey instructs Meredith to take the rapist to OR 1. Bailey sarcastically comments on the rapist's condition, demonstrating her leadership style.

title: Cristina Yang's Ambition and Professional Rivalries
description: Cristina Yang, a highly ambitious intern, navigates her professional journey with a focus on achieving surgical excellence. Her competitive nature often leads to rivalries with her peers, particularly Alex Karev, as they vie for opportunities and recognition. The season highlights her ambition, the challenges she faces in balancing her personal and professional relationships, and her pursuit of surgical success.
interfering_episode_characters: Alex Karev; George O'Malley; Miranda Bailey
single_episode_progression_string: Cristina almost runs over George with her motorcycle. Cristina is assigned to show Alex Karev how she works. Cristina and Alex deliver lab results to a family. Cristina complains about being hugged by patients. Cristina pushes Alex to receive a hug from a patient.

title: Burke's Ambition for Chief of Surgery
description: Dr. Preston Burke, a talented surgeon at Seattle Grace Hospital, harbors ambitions to become the Chief of Surgery. His professional journey involves navigating hospital politics and proving his capabilities to his superiors. The season highlights his interactions with Richard Webber, his competitive stance with Derek Shepherd, and his strategic maneuvers to achieve his career goals.
single_episode_progression_string: Burke asks Richard why Derek was invited to Seattle Grace. Burke expresses his desire to be Chief of Surgery. Richard tells Burke he won't be leaving soon. Burke declines Derek's invitation for a drink, citing competition for Chief of Surgery.
